summary: Full frontend-only regression pass at mobile viewport 390x844 on https://team-pulse-205.preview.emergentagent.com. Every feature from the review request works. Zero JS/pageerror events. Home renders weather widget, Live Now strip (3 items), Next Up card, Needs You list, Your Teams list (4 groups). All 5 bottom tabs (tab-index/groups/schedule/marketplace/me) navigate and update URL. Groups: 7 sport chips filter (All->10, Soccer->5), 10 group cards, tapping a card opens /group/g4 hub with 6 feature tiles; group-tile-chat opens /chat/g4 and chat-input + chat-send appends 'Hello team test' bubble. Schedule: date strip visible, 5 filter chips, 4 schedule cards, rsvp-going/maybe/no all toggle. Event detail (/event/e1): event-rsvp / event-directions / checkin-btn all present; check-in toggles label 'Check In' -> "You're Checked In". Marketplace: search input, 7 category chips, 6 listing cards, 6 like buttons toggle, listing detail (/listing/mk1) has message-seller-btn and make-offer-btn. Me tab: profile + 3 stats + 4 wallet cards + appearance-row. Appearance route contains all 3 theme options; sampling the DOM confirms REAL theme switching (light surfaces rgb(249,250,251)/rgb(255,255,255) vs dark surfaces rgb(15,23,42)/rgb(30,41,59)). Weather widget on Home opens /weather with Hourly (7 slots) + 5-Day Forecast. Only console output is one pre-known react-native-web deprecation warning ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated') which the review explicitly says to ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: Appearance is implemented as a full-screen route (/appearance) rather than an overlay modal. Functionally equivalent to what the review asked for (theme modal) and works correctly, but E1 may want to convert it to a presentation:'modal' stack option if a true modal is desired.
One non-blocking rn-web warning ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents') is emitted by an internal dependency — safe to ignore per review, but worth tracking if noise increases.
seed_data_creation: None — app uses local mock data in /app/frontend/src/data/mock.ts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All V1 modules (Home, Groups, Schedule + Event detail with Check-in, Marketplace + Listing detail, Me + Wallet, Weather, Theme switch) are wired to mock data and function correctly at 390x844. testIDs used: tab-index, tab-groups, tab-schedule, tab-marketplace, tab-me, weather-widget, group-code-input, groups-filter-{All|Soccer|Basketball|Pickleball|Tennis|Volleyball|Running}, group-card-{id}, group-tile-chat, chat-input, chat-send, schedule-filter-*, schedule-card-*, rsvp-going/maybe/no, event-rsvp, event-directions, checkin-btn, market-search-input, market-filter-*, listing-card-*, listing-like-*, message-seller-btn, make-offer-btn, wallet-card-*, appearance-row, theme-option-{light|dark|system}. Preview URL: https://team-pulse-205.preview.emergentagent.com.
